Rapid growth, high energy, and frequent meals. This stage builds the foundation for bones and joints. Expect a curious, energetic kitten who wants to climb and explore.

This is the lanky stage. Kittens often look tall and lean before their chest and frame fill out. Consistent nutrition and steady play help them build healthy muscle.

### 9 to 18 months

The body starts to fill out, and the coat becomes thicker. You may notice more width across the chest and shoulders.
